prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one exceptionally high-fidelity production website design comp, a desktop homepage FIRST VIEWPORT at 1536 x 1024, flat screen capture with no browser frame, no device, no outer margin. This is the actual marketing website for Birdcar, a person who helps established businesses solve messy operational work and implements sophisticated technical improvements with them. Clean, classic, type-and-animation-led design. The feeling is Silicon Valley capability made personally accessible: confident, forward-looking, luminous, human, precise. It must read as a usable website with obvious offer and action.

COMPOSITION: a 96px-tall white header, then one 660px-tall full-bleed two-region hero, then a broad white horizontal work-story preview down to the bottom edge. The hero has a broad LEFT white region occupying 65% of its width and a narrower RIGHT cobalt region occupying 35%. Only one sharp, quiet, 1px ink vertical divider. The header and lower preview are divided from the hero by fine 1px ink horizontal rules. Deliberately just two purposeful hero regions, generous whitespace, no bento grid, no stacked cards, no boxed panels. Everything aligns to clear 64px outer insets.

HEADER: black Alkaline script logo reading "Birdcar" at upper left, approximately 180px wide. Across the right side, straightforward small Archivo sans navigation: "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing", then an underlined link "Book a free assessment" with a small right arrow. Plenty of breathing space, no nav pills.

LEFT HERO: Very large dark-ink Alkaline headline around 98px on three deliberate lines: "Make room" / "for better" / "work." Exact full headline "Make room for better work." Use real Alkaline character: confident thick connected slanted brush-script lettering, smooth sharp-ended terminals, clean vintage-modern character, close to a classic bold signwriter's italic script, NOT a serif, NOT a grotesque, NOT calligraphy hairlines. The logo uses the same family. Left-align the headline at x64 around y166. Keep its entire ink safely inside the left region with generous right margin. Below at around y530 put the exact intro in Archivo medium at 25px, with natural line breaks: "I help businesses untangle work that’s become harder to keep up with." Below that at 17px/27px place two short readable paragraphs in Archivo:
"The reporting someone spends Friday assembling. The follow-up that depends on your memory. The process that keeps landing back on your desk."
"I work with you and the people doing that work to understand what’s getting in the way, then build tools and processes that make it easier to handle."
Do not truncate or compress the body. It may sit in a slightly narrower 735px text measure, with precise comfortable vertical spacing.

RIGHT HERO: one continuous cobalt #203dda region, with white text. A finely rendered almost imperceptible optical caustic of pale-blue light crosses only the upper empty right region, like precise light refracting through a polished optical surface. It is an elegant expensive tech detail, NOT a glass card, NOT fog, NOT a dramatic explosion, NOT a background grid, no physical glass partition or workshop photograph. Preserve a calm solid-blue text field. Starting about y290 and inset 44px from the pane left, display a small Red Hat Mono useful label "Free assessment". Below, a white Alkaline secondary heading, 48px, on three lines: "Let’s start with" / "what’s painful." Exact full heading "Let’s start with what’s painful." Below at 18px/28px, the exact offer paragraph in readable Archivo: "I’ll spend about an hour with you, then write up what I’ve understood and the improvements I recommend. The assessment is free. The report is yours to keep." Below near y646 place a generously proportioned rectangular white button with tiny 2px corner radius, ink Archivo text "Book a free assessment", and a small arrow to the right. It must be immediately visible and clearly actionable.

LOWER HORIZONTAL REGION: a spacious white work-story preview, full width with zero cards or thumbnail art. Left at x64 y811 a small useful mono section label "Work in practice." and below a dark Alkaline 44px title "Craft & Communicate". To the right around x660 y820, actual story prose in readable Archivo 21px/30px: "I built a client-facing reporting platform that brings together performance data and gives the agency something it can offer its customers." Below it a simple underlined "Read about the work" text link with right arrow.

PALETTE: cloud white #f8faff dominates roughly 65% of the screen, one cobalt #203dda major pane, near-black blue ink #171c28, and restrained pale-blue #becafb optical light confined to cobalt. No yellow, orange, cream, tan, green, burgundy, purple, paper or fabric texture. No gradients outside the small optical effect. Overall flat, sharp, light, classical precision with a technologically advanced finish. No shadows behind regions, no frosted-glass UI.

TYPOGRAPHY: Alkaline for logo, main heading, secondary heading and work title. Archivo for all body and navigation. Red Hat Mono only for useful small section labels. Crisp text, purposeful varying scale, high contrast, refined alignment. Do not substitute generic sans display typography or an unrelated formal cursive font.

All quoted copy is literal content and must be spelled correctly. This is one complete polished website viewport; no editorial annotations, no color swatches, no board title, no caption outside the website. Avoid invented testimonials, endorsements, company logo rows, fake metrics, screenshots, dashboards, controls, diagrams, people, stock imagery, icons beyond simple arrows, decorative numbering, grid wallpaper, made-up claims, consulting clichés, badges, cards or giant empty spacers. The real subject is the business owner's recognizable problems, Birdcar's personal help, the free assessment and retained report, and real Craft & Communicate work. Render the resting state of a page whose optical light will later move subtly on interaction.
